The loop reads this file from the BASE branch (BF4), so a branch cannot weaken the checks it is judged against; a pull request that adds checks gets them in the loop only after it merges. Commands run in the branch checkout with a credential-stripped environment; {baseRef} is replaced with the pull request's base ref. CI stays authoritative for merge.
